coverage_strategy: A restrained four-shot progression: orient both characters, isolate Eli's evasion, cut to the untouched choice, then move closer on Mara's recognition.

shots.narrative_purpose: Orient the relationship and make Mara's offer legible in one uninterrupted action.
shots.blocking: Mara sits screen-left by the window; Eli sits screen-right by the aisle; Mara slides the envelope from her right hand toward table center.
shots.action: Mara says the departure time and pushes the envelope halfway across the table; Eli stays still.
shots.performance_intent: Mara hides urgency inside practical delivery; Eli's stillness should register as resistance.

camera.position: open end of booth, three-quarter to both characters
camera.focus: deep enough to hold both faces and envelope
camera.composition: Mara left, Eli right, envelope path visible between them

shots.screen_direction: Mara addresses screen-right; Eli addresses screen-left
shots.lighting_intent: Preserve warm camera-left key and cooler background door spill.

entrance_state.current_action: Mara covers the envelope with her right hand

exit_state.current_action: The envelope has stopped halfway between them under Mara's fingertips

prop_states.ticket-envelope: sealed at table center under Mara's fingertips

tolerances: Rain pattern need not match exactly

shots.narrative_purpose: Hold on Eli long enough for his practical sentence to become a refusal.
shots.blocking: Eli remains aisle-side; Mara's soft shoulder is foreground-left; Eli looks down to the envelope then toward Mara only on the final word.
shots.action: Eli does not touch the envelope and says she should leave before the rain.

dialogue.text: You should get there before the rain.

shots.performance_intent: Gentle evasion with a late, guilty eyeline; no overt sadness.

camera.position: Mara side of the open booth, still on established camera half-plane
camera.composition: Eli right-of-center with look room toward screen-left

shots.lighting_intent: Same warm key side; background door remains cool and subdued.

entrance_state.current_action: The envelope has stopped halfway between them under Mara's fingertips

prop_states.ticket-envelope: sealed at table center under Mara's fingertips

exit_state.current_action: Eli finishes the line without touching the envelope

prop_states.ticket-envelope: sealed at table center under Mara's fingertips

tolerances: Mara shoulder silhouette may vary slightly

shots.narrative_purpose: Turn the untouched envelope into the visible answer and bridge the emotional cut.
shots.blocking: Only forearms enter frame: Mara slowly withdraws her fingertips left; Eli's hand remains near his coffee on the right and never reaches.
shots.action: The envelope stays sealed at center as Mara removes her hand.
shots.performance_intent: The withdrawal is small and final, without flourish.

camera.position: above table from established open-booth side
camera.composition: envelope centered, Mara's hand exits left, Eli's hand remains right

shots.screen_direction: Mara's hand withdraws screen-left; Eli's hand remains screen-right
shots.lighting_intent: Same warm overhead practical reflected softly on laminate.

character_positions.mara: window-side seat, right forearm in frame-left

entrance_state.current_action: Eli has finished speaking; Mara begins to withdraw her hand

exit_state.current_action: The untouched envelope remains alone at table center

prop_states.ticket-envelope: sealed and untouched at exact table center

tolerances: Coffee cup may remain soft and partly cropped

shots.narrative_purpose: Let Mara's recognition, not the prop, end the scene.
shots.blocking: Mara remains window-side; Eli's soft shoulder is foreground-right; Mara looks down, takes one breath, then looks toward Eli and says the line.
shots.action: Mara says 'I know' and holds his eyeline for one beat.
shots.performance_intent: Recognition without accusation; the smallest possible change around the eyes.

camera.position: Eli side of the open booth, same established camera half-plane
camera.movement: very slow 10 cm push beginning on her breath
camera.composition: Mara left-of-center with look room toward screen-right

shots.lighting_intent: Warm key remains camera-left; window side of her face falls gently into shadow.

entrance_state.current_action: The untouched envelope remains alone at table center

prop_states.ticket-envelope: sealed and untouched at exact table center

exit_state.current_action: Mara holds Eli's eyeline after saying 'I know'

prop_states.ticket-envelope: sealed and untouched at exact table center

tolerances: Push may be imperceptible but must not become a zoom

edit_boundaries.cut_type: straight cut with dialogue J-cut option
edit_boundaries.outgoing_action: Envelope settles and Eli lowers his eyes
edit_boundaries.incoming_action: Eli's eyes are already on the envelope before he speaks
edit_boundaries.movement_vector: Mara's hand finishes toward center; Eli remains anchored screen-right
edit_boundaries.spatial_relationship: Master to Eli OTS without crossing the dialogue axis
edit_boundaries.screen_direction: Eli retains screen-left eyeline toward Mara
edit_boundaries.visual_bridge: The envelope occupies the lower eyeline target in both shots
edit_boundaries.audio_bridge: Diner room tone continues; Eli's breath may begin under SH001 tail
edit_boundaries.intended_cut_point: After the envelope stops, before Eli begins the line
edit_boundaries.required_handles: At least 0.5 seconds of Eli looking down before speech
edit_boundaries.fallback: Hold SH001 longer and omit the J-cut

edit_boundaries.outgoing_action: Eli completes the line looking toward Mara
edit_boundaries.incoming_action: Mara's fingertips begin withdrawing from the envelope
edit_boundaries.movement_vector: Attention moves from Eli's leftward eyeline to the centered envelope, then hand moves left
edit_boundaries.spatial_relationship: Insert stays on established camera side and preserves Mara-left/Eli-right hand positions
edit_boundaries.screen_direction: No reversal; Mara's hand exits screen-left
edit_boundaries.visual_bridge: Envelope referenced by Eli's prior glance
edit_boundaries.audio_bridge: Room tone and rain continue; no score
edit_boundaries.intended_cut_point: On the silence immediately after Eli's final word
edit_boundaries.required_handles: Clean silence before hand motion and after it settles
edit_boundaries.fallback: Cut directly from SH002 to SH004 and keep envelope state implicit

edit_boundaries.outgoing_action: Mara's hand finishes withdrawing, leaving the envelope alone
edit_boundaries.incoming_action: Mara begins the breath that precedes her line
edit_boundaries.movement_vector: Leftward hand withdrawal resolves into stillness before the close-up
edit_boundaries.spatial_relationship: Insert to Mara reverse OTS on the same axis half-plane
edit_boundaries.screen_direction: Mara retains screen-right eyeline toward Eli
edit_boundaries.visual_bridge: Mara's withdrawal motivates cutting from hand to face
edit_boundaries.audio_bridge: Her inhale starts as an optional J-cut over the settled insert
edit_boundaries.intended_cut_point: After the hand settles, just before the inhale
edit_boundaries.required_handles: At least 0.5 seconds of settled envelope and 0.8 seconds before Mara speaks
edit_boundaries.fallback: Use the inhale as a hard audio cue if the visual settle is unstable
